name: secsearch
description: **SecSearch Pro** is a modern, zero-knowledge, client-side privacy search engine. Built with a single-file architecture (`index.html`), it blends the minimalist privacy-first aesthetic of Qwant with the rich, widget-driven layout of modern search engines like Bing. The application operates on a **Zero-Knowledge Client** paradigm: all credentials, search tokens, and custom API endpoints are stored exclusively within the user's local browser environment (`localStorage`), ensuring zero server-side logging or telemetry.
